parent_report: Prediction Is Not Permission, prepublication v1.2 (revised local release of 18 October 2026)
parent_study: incident-dynamics-v2 (docs/research/incident_dynamics_result_v2.json); its selected pipelines are the primary comparators
purpose: Test whether a broader incident-motivated mechanism library, longer causal history, new model families, uncertainty-aware warnings and a Dream-RSI-inspired evolving-world curriculum improve prediction and delayed-constraint warnings beyond the v2-selected models, without changing execution authority or rewriting earlier negative results.
research_sources: docs/research/incident_dynamics_sources_v3.json (24 newly verified primary sources plus the eight v1 sources; narratives motivate abstract perturbation families only)

development.mechanism_library: scripts/incident_dynamics_v3_data.py OS_MECHANISMS and PHYSICAL_MECHANISMS (10 families per domain)

held_out_mechanisms.rule: Generated only for the registered final catalog; mechanism_rows raises PermissionError for any other partition.

data.base: Unchanged v2 development partitions: original legacy development rows plus incident_rows(train, 1200, 281001) and incident_rows(validation, 256, 281002). History-3 windows are verified byte-identical to v2.
data.calibration: incident_rows(calibration, 512, 281003) plus 64 episodes per development mechanism, seed 391003

development.selection_metric: Equal-weight mean of (a) the v2-identical base validation score and (b) the development-mechanism validation score; each is the mean of H1/H3/H5 episode-macro normalized MAE. No final or held-out-mechanism input.
development.dream_rsi: Adapted, not reimplemented: online probing of candidate development worlds, an evolving world pool, offline replay scoring of candidate continuations on every stored world, and retention of the current model among candidates. No held-out mechanism or final input enters probing or replay.
development.warnings: Score = maximum signed constraint margin over the forecast; optional uncertainty shift of k times the predicted Laplace scale (k=0 reproduces v2). Threshold rule unchanged from v2: smallest score threshold with at most 1 percent empirical calibration FPR.
development.ledger: target/incident-dynamics-v3/development_ledger.jsonl and per-trial JSON records; archived with the selection manifest.

pre_plan_probes_disclosed: Noise-only oracle on the development generator and on the public v2 final generator with an unregistered seed (999): true state, drift and regime known, only stochastic noise unknown. No model was evaluated on final-generator samples.

Generator sanity probe: 64 episodes of every mechanism, including the three held-out families per domain, under partition 'probe', reporting only window counts, hazard prevalence and finiteness. No model was scored on held-out mechanisms. The partition guard was added immediately afterwards.

populations.A_paper_population: Fresh seed from the unchanged v2 final generator (incident_rows partition 'final'). Directly comparable with the paper's Section 8.7 population. The v3 development curriculum contains regime-change mechanisms, so A is no longer a timing holdout for v3 models; this must be stated.
populations.B_novel_mechanisms: Fresh seed; held-out mechanism families only. Novel-mechanism holdout within the same researcher-designed simulator.
populations.historical: Previously opened paper final families; regression guard only.

evaluation_policy.gates: Registered in docs/research/incident_dynamics_protocol_v3.json before the selection manifest is frozen.

claim_boundaries: Prediction or warning improvement does not establish fewer real incidents, controller benefit, physical safety, or permission.
No exploit code, live attacks, or network capability. Public incident mechanisms are represented by local abstract perturbations only; source identities do not supply numeric coefficients or labels.
All earlier negative and failed results remain unchanged and retained.

amendments.change: Selection metric replaced before any selection: the base-plus-mechanism mean was dominated by legacy QEMU rows (about ten times larger errors) although both registered populations are incident-only. The registered metric is the mean over legacy, v2-incident and development-mechanism blocks of block score divided by the v2-selected block score.
amendments.trials_affected: p01, o01, o02 were scored under the earlier metric at run time; every retained trial is rescored under the registered metric.

amendments.change: Candidate families extended with gradient-boosted (LightGBM) residual corrections on the frozen v2-selected model, autoregressive and direct multi-horizon, after development evidence showed neural corrections lose precision on the v2-incident block. A learned warning-scale add-on was also tried.

Compute reallocation: GPU neural queues stopped once boosted families dominated on development data; repeated laptop-GPU 'illegal instruction' faults and one RAM exhaustion are logged in infrastructure_failures.jsonl. The Dream-RSI-inspired arm is run on the FerrumOS direct boosted family only; no physical RSI arm.
